question: At the two-minute mark in the YouTube video uploaded by the channel “GameGrumps” on May 14, 2017 as part of their playthrough of the game Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, the shows’ hosts are competing on one of the game’s racetracks. What was the world record time for that track in the game’s 150cc mode as of June 7, 2023? Express your answer in minutes and seconds, rounding the seconds to the nearest hundredth, e.g. 1:01.001.

history.content: I opened MKWRS and used the World Records Snapshot feature to select the date June 7, 2023. For MK8DX 150cc, Dragon Driftway shows 1:41.614. That is the listed world record on that date.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: I additionally checked an archived MKWRS Dragon Driftway MK8DX 150cc page via the Wayback Machine captured near June 7, 2023. It corroborates the 1:41.614 record. The snapshot confirms both the category (MK8DX 150cc) and the exact time.
